$comment: Known-failing tests on the PHI remediation baseline (commit d1dcac1).
These are PRE-EXISTING product/test disagreements that were invisible until
T0.1 repaired the ESM setup and the suite actually executed for the first
time. They are quarantined here -- not deleted, not skipped -- so that CI can
gate on the suite from day one while the remediation lanes work.
scripts/check-test-baseline.mjs enforces this list in BOTH directions:
* a test that fails and is NOT listed here  -> CI fails (a regression)
* a test that is listed here and now PASSES -> CI fails (prune the entry)
The second direction is what stops this file from silently rotting into a
